$comment: CI cost manifest required by spec 06 A-PM-12 / ADR-0014 decision 6. Schema (pipeline / minutes / runner_class / est_usd) per spec 06 line 277; unit prices per spec 07 line 172; cap split per ADR-0014 line 235. Every minutes_per_run and runs_per_month below is an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE ASSUMPTION, not a measurement - spec 06 A-PM-12 asks for the manifest to be complete and for the month to be under the cap, and ADR-0014 frames the estimate as order-of-magnitude. Replace the assumptions with runner telemetry once available.

assumptions.runs_per_month_basis: push + pull_request on active development; not a measured figure
assumptions.fuzz_and_soak: self-hosted only, so their cloud cost contribution is 0 (ADR-0014 line 220)

not_included: signing and notarisation fixed fees (spec 07 line 172 lists them separately)
self-hosted depreciation, power and bandwidth (the 1800 self-hosted cap)
the 12-combination matrix and nightly fuzz, which do not exist yet; wiring them is what the estimate must be revisited for
